title: Kiki Katese's Case for an Ice-Cream Shop in Butare
conflicts: Sundance meeting dated 2008 (Edible Brooklyn) or 2009 (Al Jazeera filmmakers): story says 'late 2000s'. Ingoma Nshya founded 2004 (New Times, Farm Radio) or 2005 (Al Jazeera): no year given. Opening June 2010 (Optimist Daily) / summer 2010 (Edible Brooklyn) vs 'end of 2010' (Farm Radio): story says mid-2010.
notes: Funding changed from the slate's 'nonprofit' to 'mixed': nonprofit seed money (Blue Marble Dreams), a cooperative business, and early JICA support. Katese's 'I want to talk to you about ice cream' rests on one source (Optimist Daily) and is flagged 'by one account'; 'no room to dream' is Miesen's recollection of Katese and attributed so. Town called Butare as in the sources (Huye District).
